stages.scope: Three archived controllers, original million-clock wait; explicit lock stimuli.
Unmodified vendor model under original top reset=0 must match known-good hardware startup before whole-system validation.
Simulation-only model initialization, if present, is an explicit assumption and never a production PLL change.
Exact two-sector data, CRC and CS-interruption recovery through real SD controller; not full FAT32/BMP/WAV integration.
C11206/C11309/C11310 nominal TF/FAT32/BMP/WAV/framebuffer; latter two each three real FFT frames and 72 exact bands; explicit model/port-width assumptions.
Nominal SD pin/FAT32/BMP/WAV route, original startup wait; no direct PCM injection; short test fixtures only.
Actual framebuffer/FIFO/codec with independent full-frame gold; physical SDRAM controller/model remains unqualified.

Unchanged production controller independently synthesized to gate, native PADs and APUG011 pin model; 1024 words/four banks/masks/post-refresh and exact one-bit negative. Whole-top still uses application model; not routed SiP timing.

Three archived whole tops through SD/media/real core/PHY pins; strict 1536000 RGB pixels after first cold frame, ordered real-WAV stereo; FFT and visible bars in spectrum versions. Explicit model assumptions remain.
Nominal whole top verified; long KEY1 and non-nominal clock/reset/card timing matrix incomplete.
Do not silently omit unsupported cells or timing checks.
Electrical behavior and actual external devices require final hardware acceptance.
